answer_4.quote: We conducted a user study with 20 participants to investigate how understandable the perturbed texts are to humans. ... In the first part of the study, each participant was given 30 perturbed samples ... and were asked to judge if the perturbed text is understandable and still conveys the same meaning. ... In the second part of the study, each participant was given 20 perturbed samples ... and were asked to judge (with respect to the task at hand) if the perturbed text is still meaningful and consistent with the test set label.
answer_4.guideline: Participants judged whether the perturbed text is understandable and still conveys the same meaning (first part) or is meaningful and consistent with the original label (second part).
